svg.title: The evidence boundary
svg.desc: Magnify the boundary between the two prior frames, preserving their edge treatments. No text or speech tail crosses it; the visual rule is about evidence class, not merely color coding. Visual distinction: A firm source edge with incomplete outer brackets. The blank gutter marks the limit of review, not destruction or proof of absence.
